mapper.sql: select r.room_id,r.activity_id,r.hotel_id,r.room_name,r.bed_type,r.price,r.stock,r.reserved_stock,r.sort_order, r.del_flag,r.create_by,r.create_time,r.update_by,r.update_time,r.remark,h.hotel_name from yc_hotel_room r left join yc_hotel h on h.hotel_id=r.hotel_id and h.del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select count(1) as totalCount from yc_hotel_room where activity_id=#{activityId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.update: update yc_hotel_room set reserved_stock=reserved_stock+#{quantity},update_time=sysdate() where room_id=#{roomId} and del_flag='0' and (stock=0 or reserved_stock+#{quantity}<=stock)
update yc_hotel_room set reserved_stock=greatest(0,reserved_stock-#{quantity}),update_time=sysdate() where room_id=#{roomId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.delete: update yc_hotel_room set del_flag='2' where room_id in #{id}
